Paragraph: I deem that each of you are the choicest ones to protect the entire earth adorned with Mt. Meru and Vindhya, and with all her oceans and forests.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hanuman expresses his conviction of the princes' fitness for great responsibility despite their current humble state.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Affirms their latent capability and worth with confident, generous praise.
Outcome/Resolution: Reinforces trust and goodwill in the budding relationship.
Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman perceives the shakti, innate potency, within Rama and Lakshmana to protect the whole earth.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Reflects esteem-building affirmation - recognizing another's capability even amid apparent hardship.
